definitions: To cut something in order to make it neater or more even.
To reduce the size, amount, or extent of something.
To decorate or adorn something, especially with ribbons or other embellishments.
To adjust the balance of a ship or aircraft by shifting weight or adjusting control surfaces.
examples: She needs to trim her hair.
We need to trim the budget.
The dress was trimmed with lace.
The pilot trimmed the aircraft for level flight.
